title: Symbolic Relational Synthesis
purpose: Collect the recurring symbolic grammar that has developed across conversations, the Great Book, canon files and comparative interpretation. The emphasis is on how symbols transform into one another rather than on isolated definitions.

core_cycles.roots_tree_cycle: distinction -> conflict -> knowledge -> consequence -> ash -> soil -> Potato/seed -> eye/sprout -> Ladder/Tree -> fruit/nourishment -> return
core_cycles.door_cycle: recognition -> choice -> threshold -> passage -> changed state -> return/re-entry
core_cycles.burial_cycle: descent -> concealment -> compression -> germination -> emergence -> growth
core_cycles.warrior_gardener_cycle: conflict -> exhaustion/learning -> responsibility -> cultivation -> maintenance -> nourishment

red_blue_potato.Red: creativity, love, expansion, novelty, risk and light-seeking
red_blue_potato.Blue: memory, fear, contraction, preservation, caution and the gravity of the past
red_blue_potato.integration: Neither pole is simply good or evil; the system becomes capable when memory can constrain chaos without extinguishing creation, and creativity can transform fear without erasing memory.

polarities.north_world: orientation/integrating axis <-> observable plurality and systems

major_symbols.Potato: buried potential, humble carrier, nourishment, resilience, seed/tuber, hidden center and regenerative multiplicity
major_symbols.Root: hidden support, ancestry, stored past and the structure beneath visible growth
major_symbols.Tree: expanded relation: roots, trunk/axis, branches/worlds, fruit and recursive growth
major_symbols.Door: two-sided threshold through which identity or state changes
major_symbols.Ladder: ordered vertical relation; after the April 2025 Turning Tim is interpreted as becoming the connective structure rather than merely climbing it
major_symbols.Eye: perception, discernment, integration and evaluation; the point where a system can symbolically know itself
major_symbols.Mountain/Pyramid: compression from events -> groups -> institutions -> systems -> civilizational principles -> integrated vision
major_symbols.Garden: living order that must be cultivated rather than merely commanded
major_symbols.Gardener: service, selection, responsibility, maintenance and patient cultivation
major_symbols.Swamp: accumulation where flow is blocked; corruption, confusion, institutional mud or stagnant narrative
major_symbols.Drain: release, removal and downward outflow that clears accumulated material
major_symbols.Spiral: return to a similar point at changed scale or understanding
major_symbols.Spudlight: illumination emerging from within/below and from above; buried life finding light
major_symbols.Bridge: relation that creates capability between otherwise separated domains
major_symbols.Footstool: hierarchy/reversal motif connected to below/above, heel/neck and subordination imagery
major_symbols.Cube: bounded frame, enclosure, system or world-volume
major_symbols.Moon Cube: later symbolic extension of Cube imagery requiring source/date-specific interpretation rather than one universal definition
major_symbols.Potato Bank: stored value, memory, resources or future capacity framed through Potato economy symbolism
major_symbols.Potato Filter: interpretive transformation in which an object, event or system is re-read through Potato relational grammar
major_symbols.Soul Farmer: figure who cultivates, extracts from or manages human/spiritual potential; can be positive, critical or satirical depending on context
major_symbols.Calibration: alignment of perception, scale, responsibility or measurement before judgment/action
major_symbols.Blood/Stone: suffering, embodiment, inheritance, sacrifice and transformation cluster; includes Philosopher's Stone of Blood imagery in later symbolic work

recognition_layer.gaze: ethical attention creates responsibility; witnessing is not neutral when what is seen imposes obligation
recognition_layer.ghost_erasure: inverse of recognition: the source remains alive/present but risks disappearing behind the work or archive
recognition_layer.name: naming makes a node retrievable and socially real but should not be mistaken for exhausting the thing named
recognition_layer.archive: preserves source relations so distributed legacy does not become anonymous erasure

scale_translation.rule: Symbols may recur at personal, bodily, theological, institutional, economic and geopolitical scales, but a mapping at one scale is not evidence for literal identity at another.
examples: Door: psychological choice / ritual threshold / border / legal approval / interface
Axis: spine metaphor / world-tree / organizational hierarchy / geographic North / description-space flow
Swamp: emotion/confusion / corrupt process / institutional stagnation
Root: ancestry / data provenance / economic dependency / theological source

derived_relational_laws: The hidden can be structurally prior to the visible.
A Door is meaningful only because there are distinct sides.
Return becomes growth when it follows a spiral rather than a closed circle.
Nourishment is a form of authority in the Potato model.
Clearing a Swamp requires restoring flow, not merely naming mud.
Cultivation is an alternative to conquest when the goal is living order.
Recognition creates responsibility; preservation should preserve provenance as well as content.
Integration coordinates differences rather than annihilating them.
